grouping: Month or weekday of starting close label. Ending close may cross month or weekday. All groups retained.
primary_return: 100*(close[t+h]/close[t]-1), a descriptive close-mark change, not an achievable same-close order.
execution_sensitivity: 100*(close[t+h]-open[t+1]-cost)/open[t+1], cost0 or1 total point per hypothetical round trip. No actual fill, margin or account return.
phase_rule: All: any complete forward horizon. Before2020: both start and end before2020. Later: start>=2020. Crossing horizons omitted only from two-phase comparison, retained in All.
limits: Date-only continuous-series history, originally explored. No intraday 30-minute source recovery, cash-index reproduction, independent-trial inference or native session/roll proof.
